market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Fed hike and $100 oil create headwinds, but tech/AI rally and gold bid provide support. S&P/Nasdaq above key levels but Dow futures pulling back. Expect 2-3% volatility in equities. Yen weakness may trigger intervention risk. Oil and shipping names outperform. Consumer stress builds. One more Fed hike likely by year-end.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle and green energy transition support structural growth. However, $100+ oil, persistent inflation, and geopolitical fragmentation cap multiples. U.S. wealth concentration and consumer affordability are medium-term risks. EM bifurcation continues. Rate normalization supports financials but pressures duration assets.
